description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain with a Tsawwassen location offering delivery and takeout of gourmet-inspired pizzas made with organic tomato sauce and antibiotic-free meats. The menu spans classic and specialty pizzas alongside wings, salads, cheesy bread, and desserts, with dedicated vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-smart options. For a touring cyclist passing through Delta, it provides a wide range of filling, customisable meal choices.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (5518 12 AVE Delta BC V4M 4C2) and URL match OSM. However, the location page explicitly lists all seven days as 'Closed', which conflicts with OSM opening_hours checked as recently as 2026-01-13 — this may indicate permanent closure or a hours-rendering failure, warranting review. Vegan/vegetarian/gluten-smart options are confirmed by both OSM diet tags and the website phrase 'Panago offers vegan, vegetarian and gluten-smart options'; takeout is confirmed by OSM takeaway=yes.
concerns: Website location page lists every day (Mon–Sun) as 'Closed', conflicting with OSM opening_hours (Su-Th 11:00-24:00, Fr-Sa 11:00-25:00) checked 2026-01-13 — possible permanent closure or hours rendering failure; recommend on-the-ground or phone verification.
Phone number 310-0001 shown on website is the chain-wide ordering line, not a direct location number; OSM has no phone recorded for this location.
